description: Architectural guardrails that keep the router thin. The router stores no vectors and no corpus content (only registry + metrics tables) and contains zero provider-specific code — a new provider is a registry row only. Enforced by tests, not convention.

requirements.title: No data accretion (no qdrant, no corpus tables)
requirements.description: An architectural test asserts the router module imports no qdrant client and declares no corpus-content tables — only registry and metrics tables.

validation.notes: Source scan finds no qdrant import in the router/registry/routing packages.
Schema declares only registry + metrics tables (allow-list assertion).

requirements.title: No provider-specific code (a row, not a branch)
requirements.description: Adding a fixture provider requires only a registry row; the router has no `if type == ...` provider branches. A test registers a fixture provider and federates it with no router source change.

validation.notes: A fixture provider added purely via RegisterProvider is reachable through Query with no code change.
